title: astragalus sempervirens subsp. muticus
intro: Astragalus sempervirens subsp. muticus, commonly known as Chinese milkvetch or huang qi, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported health benefits including immune system support, anti-inflammatory effects, and cardiovascular protection. The therapeutic actions of Chinese milkvetch are attributed to its ability to tonify the Qi, or vital energy, and its potential to modulate the immune system, making it a sought-after ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Chinese milkvetch include isoflavones, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
